summary: Jefferies Credit Partners BDC Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a regular cash distribution on its Class I and Class S common shares. The gross distribution is $0.1191 per Class I share and $0.1181 per Class S share, with a shareholder servicing/distribution fee of $0.0104 deducted from Class S shares, resulting in a net distribution of $0.1077 for Class S. The distribution is payable June 18, 2026 to holders of record May 29, 2026, and may be paid in cash or reinvested under the company's distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation elements — this is a routine periodic distribution.
